_commentaire: Deposit point of the "Deposit" screen (§113 D-MAILROOM-DEPOSIT). Each PDF deposited by an agent becomes a mail item (PAPIER channel) that follows the same sorting as e-mail. The sender entered goes to the expediteur field, the subject to objet (otherwise the file name). Only agents with the EDIT ACL on the COURRIER type see this deposit point.
name: Paper mail (front desk)
